sheets.medium: the substances: water, air, ink, glass, paper, light, sound, code, data, type
what a substance does: opacity, viscosity, refraction, rhythm
what happens over time: diffusion, advection, layering, erosion, overprint
the shapes processes leave: mosaic, ribbon, glyph, field, path
how a view is arranged: depth planes, horizon, temperature, reading order
the laws that apply: physical, craft, canon and music rules
what it is about: translation as depth, noise as signal, time as material
